R7: an item used ROTATE_AFTER_USES times is retired, never selected, and still re-scores; one below stays

R16: a T2 plan for ask holds no transcription item; one for transcribe does
R17: an entry with only not_suitable verdicts is refused T3 by name; one part passed admits it
R18: a wrong identity, an unhonoured pin or no tools stops at T0; failing every G2 item stops G5 of that part; one G2 pass does not
R20: an address is refused on the cloudflare route and accepted on machine; a public DNS name is accepted on both
R25: a quote differing only by a curly quote and a double space passes; a changed word fails
R31: scoreItem is pure (byte-identical twice); a v2 scorer re-scores stored exchanges with no model call; a different exchange differs
R32: scoreAnswerFree runs with no private bank and is labelled preliminary; an answer-bound check without it answers ok: false
R33: groupFigures gives counts and Wilson intervals at CI_LEVEL; not_run items are outside n
R34: the shipped table is empty and with it every part is not_yet_rated with its figures; a table with floors gives a verdict
R35: failing only G4 gives not_suitable for ask and passes for transcribe; passing everything gives passes; a verdict per part
R36: an entry without image input has no_image_input for read and none for run; a full entry has none
R37: the gate record names entry, part and the four versions and is the shape run-rules reads; without an entry id it is refused
R38: a bundle draws on the bank only, Civicsmith's runs on both; a bundle selection holds no matter of the set
R39: a new threshold table re-rates stored figures with no model call; the old record is unchanged
R40: a reading note changes no verdict, record or row; the verdict path takes no note; the note carries its reviewer and date
R41: a record lacking any condition is refused; a changed adapter version marks it stale; no samples reads OPEN
R43: too few turns, or all in one window, is OPEN with the shortfall; the full count across days gives a value
R44: error counts from a fake provider's calls match, each k of n with its interval; a clean run gives zeros with n stated
R45: recall to 64K of a stated 200K gives effective 64K and the context_depth limit; a full-window stub gives the stated value
R47: an uptime value without a period is refused; three labelled sources are accepted side by side
R48: plan scope and privacy are links to the catalogue, never measured; a missing answer reads OPEN
R49: the estimate is hand-computable from token profiles × price × repeats with session start, retries and the claimed cache
R50: usage at the ceiling answers stop; one unit below answers ok; a ceiling under the low estimate is shown with its warning
R51: no consent record without a person's explicit consent; with it the record holds the estimate shown
R52: the canary is the fixed subset at REPEATS.canary; overlapping intervals are same, a drop below is diverged; lapsed or retest-off refused
R53: each trigger yields its signal and reason; drift alone never proposes lapsed; a same canary yields none
R54: the manifest holds every field, as canonical JSON, with no payload member and no secret; a manifest with a grade is refused by the verifier
R55: a built payload has exactly the members named; an extra member, or a team's record, fails checkPayload
R56: a payload sealed to a test key opens with its private half and no other; the run signature verifies; a flipped byte breaks it
R57: readManifest reads the manifest with no key in scope and never decrypts
R58: the sentinel key, its base64 and an sk-shaped string are each found; a clean payload passes; the name rule holds
R59: each failure is unverified with its check named; a planted secret is rejected; an untouched bundle is verified
R60: a challenge for another bank version, an expired one and one with a short nonce are each refused; a matching one is accepted
R61: a bundle is REPORTED whatever its manifest says; a Civicsmith run REPRODUCED; both kept side by side
R62: divergence compares a verified bundle's figures with the baseline by interval overlap
R63: a row from a bundle for an unlisted AI has no team, exchange, request or response key; with consent it has team_name; an unverified bundle builds none
R67: results {4,5} and {5,5} pool to {9,10} with its interval; a seven-month-old result is left out; one alone gives its own
R64: an entry with ask not_suitable and transcribe passes is refused ask; passes_with_limits is not refused
